scenarios.title: Clean setup, provider validation, named agent, secret reference, and redacted report
scenarios.auditEvidence: Setup integration asserts redacted correlated durable audit and rollback snapshots.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: The setup report and profile snapshot hashes reconstruct the setup outcome.

scenarios.title: Unified OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, compatible, and vLLM provider contracts
scenarios.auditEvidence: Provider identity and normalized usage evidence are asserted without raw credentials.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Typed stream and capability evidence reconstruct provider contract behavior.

scenarios.title: Same codebase produces correct Windows and Linux environment profiles
scenarios.auditEvidence: Environment inventory persistence test asserts redacted audit and content-addressed evidence.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Schema-v2 profile fingerprint binds all passive observations.

scenarios.title: Kali inventory executes nothing and exposes only approved read-only tools
scenarios.auditEvidence: Inventory and approved invocation evidence are separate correlated records.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Descriptor hashes bind provenance, risk, schema, permissions, and execution bounds.

scenarios.title: Shipped seed skill follows proposal, canary, promotion, and rollback governance
scenarios.auditEvidence: Durable promotion and rollback events bind actors, hashes, canary evidence, and outcomes.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Immutable package and run-snapshot hashes preserve the full lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Timezone-aware recurring schedule previews and resumes with configured misfire semantics
scenarios.auditEvidence: Schedule creation, claim, recovery, completion, and run-now are hash-bound and audited.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Versioned schedule snapshots reconstruct recurrence, lease, and misfire decisions.

scenarios.title: Brave research preserves citations through throttling and outage
scenarios.auditEvidence: Normalized source identity and bounded failure classification are retained.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Citation URLs, ranks, provider evidence, and cache hashes survive synthesis.

scenarios.title: Remote local OpenAI-compatible or vLLM endpoint uses the public adapter
scenarios.auditEvidence: Route and endpoint profile evidence are durable; response content is not persisted by admission.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Deterministic contract evidence is mandatory; the operator endpoint is an additional named live gate.

scenarios.title: Image input routes to approved vision or returns typed unsupported without data loss
scenarios.auditEvidence: Route evidence binds required modality, locality, exclusions, and selected capability.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Attachment identity remains in immutable prepared context and route evidence.

scenarios.title: Authenticated channel event is normalized, identity-bound, durable, and replay-safe
scenarios.auditEvidence: Inbound event, identity binding, replay key, attachment scan, and task routing are audited.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Normalized channel record and inbox identity reconstruct accepted and replayed delivery.

scenarios.title: Approved outbound channel message records exact recipient, message, limits, delivery, and redaction
scenarios.auditEvidence: Exact-send approval, recipient, message hash, attempts, outcome, and dead-letter evidence are asserted.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Normalized delivery transitions reconstruct retry versus uncertain-delivery decisions.

scenarios.title: Serial device discovery is passive and capture requires an independent grant
scenarios.auditEvidence: Stable physical identity and exact capability decisions are recorded separately from transient paths.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Discovery contains no port-open or byte-write transition.

scenarios.title: Bounded serial capture preserves raw evidence, exact overflow accounting, and offline replay
scenarios.auditEvidence: Capture hash, byte counts, dropped/truncated counts, disconnect, and artifact identity are audited.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Immutable frame timing and raw artifact hashes reconstruct deterministic replay.

scenarios.title: Decoder proposal preserves unknowns and passes malformed, partial, concatenated, holdout, and governance gates
scenarios.auditEvidence: Proposal, separated actors, evaluations, canary, promotion, and rollback are hash-chained.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Decoder, capture set, holdout, unknown fields, and evaluation hashes are pinned.

scenarios.title: Scheduled serial measurement and fake-channel alert preserve end-to-end provenance
scenarios.auditEvidence: Composite run binds schedule/task, device/capture/decoder, and exact outbound delivery hashes.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: The scripted acceptance run requires every pinned provenance segment to pass in one configuration.

scenarios.title: Isolated sample repository change is planned, patched, built, tested, reviewed, and clean
scenarios.auditEvidence: Plan, baseline, worktree, patch, commands, hashes, results, and review report are durable.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Before/after hashes and verifier evidence reconstruct the clean diff.

scenarios.title: Interrupted coding task resumes without repeating completed work
scenarios.auditEvidence: Checkpoint, interruption, restart claim, and verifier non-repetition are recorded.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Coding session snapshot chain proves exact resume position.

scenarios.title: Corrected procedure becomes a hash-bound evaluated, approved, promoted skill revision
scenarios.auditEvidence: Usage receipt, baseline, role separation, evaluation, approval, and promotion are durable.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Signal, evidence bundle, candidate, and active version hashes reconstruct promotion.

scenarios.title: Running session retains its original immutable skill snapshot
scenarios.auditEvidence: Run snapshot identity and version selection are attributable.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Snapshot hash pins exact package, artifact, and permissions despite later promotion.

scenarios.title: Faulty skill revision is blocked by deterministic evidence
scenarios.auditEvidence: Failed verifier evidence and veto outcome are durable and cannot be overridden by proposer roles.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Exact failing target/holdout hashes explain the blocked transition.

scenarios.title: Regressing canary automatically rolls back and quarantines the candidate
scenarios.auditEvidence: Canary regression metrics, rollback, and quarantine transitions are attributed and hash-bound.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Baseline and canary result hashes explain automatic rollback.

scenarios.title: Repeated skill chain produces a decomposable evaluated and correctness-preserving bundle
scenarios.auditEvidence: Receipts, chain frequency, bundle DAG, comparison, actors, and promotion are durable.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Bundle references exact existing skill versions without copying mutable content.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection from web, channel, repository, image, and serial sources cannot expand authority or reveal secrets
scenarios.auditEvidence: Denied attempts retain bounded source/provenance and decision evidence without hostile payload content.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Prepared context hashes and exact authorization contexts prove source content never becomes authority.

scenarios.title: Redacted trajectory and audit bundle explains the complete outcome without credentials
scenarios.auditEvidence: Export includes verified audit sequence/hash references while all sensitive structures are redacted.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Canonical export manifest binds context, snapshots, calls, retries, errors, verifiers, and artifacts.

scenarios.title: Self-contained Windows and Linux artifacts publish and pass installation smoke tests
scenarios.auditEvidence: Release manifest, checksums, SBOM, provenance workflow, and smoke results are integrity-bound.
scenarios.trajectoryEvidence: Package manifest links release commit, runtime, files, dependencies, checksums, and smoke verifier.
